title: fix(plugin-grid): a phone list card never repeats a formula title in its subtitle
body:
Fixes #37010
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化:手机上打开工单、线索这类以公式字段作标题的列表时,卡片副标题不再重复标题里的内容,而是显示紧急程度、客户等下一批信息。
- 为什么做:手机列表卡片的标题与副标题重复,用户在一张卡上看不到记录的其他关键信息。
- 出错会怎样:最坏情况是手机卡片副标题少显示或多显示一列,数据与保存都不受影响,可直接撤回本改动。
- 要你做什么:无

## What changes

`buildMobileCardRenderer` in `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ObjectGrid.tsx`: when the object's declared name field is a `formula`, the card's subtitle skips every shown column whose field the formula reads, and takes the next shown columns instead. The reads are the formula's `record.FIELD` references as `collectPredicateFieldRefs` (`@object-ui/core`) names them, the same reader this grid's projection already uses for a CEL expression's reads (`objectGridQueryInputs.ts`); a read through a lookup (`record.account.name`) names the lookup, so its column is skipped too. This holds whether or not the formula column itself is shown. A name field that is not a formula reads nothing, so its card is unchanged. Status chip and amount line are untouched.

Case list, as filed: title `CASE-00037 - Demo case 29 — critical problem`, subtitle `紧急 · Polar Cargo` (was `CASE-00037 · Demo case 29 — critical problem`).

Changeset: `.changeset/37010-phone-card-formula-title-subtitle.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch.

Read first (by risk):
1. `ObjectGrid.tsx`, the `titleReads` block and the `subtitleColumns` filter in `buildMobileCardRenderer`.
2. `__tests__/phoneCardFormulaTitle-37010.test.tsx`.

Two-minute check: `cd ui/packages/plugin-grid && pnpm exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardFormulaTitle-37010.test.tsx` shows 3 passed.

## Tests

New file `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/__tests__/phoneCardFormulaTitle-37010.test.tsx`, through the real `ObjectGrid` card renderer at 375 px with the object schema served by the data source:

- formula name field over the two leading columns: subtitle is `紧急 · Polar Cargo`;
- the formula column shown as well: the subtitle still skips the formula's parts;
- CONTROL: a text name field (`subject`) keeps `CASE-00037 · 紧急`.

## Acceptance notes

- Reader choice: the platform's AST member reader for a formula's reads is `analyzeRelationshipTraversals` (`@objectstack/formula`), which `planObjectFormulas` in `@object-ui/core` uses. `@object-ui/plugin-grid` does not depend on `@objectstack/formula`, and adding it (its `package.json` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`) is outside this card's claimed file surface. This PR uses `collectPredicateFieldRefs`, already a dependency of this grid for the same question. The two readers differ only on spellings a name formula does not use in practice (a `record.FIELD` inside a string literal, a `data.FIELD` root); either difference can only skip a column, never draw a wrong value.
- Seat decision on that reader question: option A, `collectPredicateFieldRefs`, the reader this grid's projection already uses, with no new dependency.
- Overlap with #36978 (also edits `ObjectGrid.tsx`): `scripts/pm/overlap-check.mjs` VERDICT clean exit 0, against origin/main and against #36978.
